regions.full_page: Eliz. Reuschling 44 non catholic enrolled by Cath. neighbor in June - full of cancer - liver, stomach, throat, breast and 27 on her back. Suffered terribly wanted to be a Catholic but had lost her sight, and at times mind also. Hour and half before death received sight - seeing husband and friends - and something else that extremely de- lighted her. Clapping her hands and exclaiming "O how beautiful!", died very happily - bidding husband & all "Good Bye".

regions.full_page: Catherine Arata from Cincinnati in anxiety arives here by interurban trolley at 9 a.m. enrolls Jewish Banker Samuel Lehman who cheated her of her "will and legacy $10,000. and now is in dying condition. We hope he will wake up and get a conscience before going before God.

Horny who had enrolled John Daley her 14 yr-old nephew two days ago as an annual member, requested over phone that I enroll him now as perpe- tual member. Before requesting the perpetual membership complained that the boy had very little improved. Now tells me he has gone into good sleep. pertinitis

regions.full_page: Ed. Martz enrolls Poor Souls whenever trouble threatens. Night be- fore last he enrolled them that they might help him find mistake of $10,000.00. Yesterday first thing in the morning the mistake was discovered without the least delay. Bank with which the deal made the mistake. Ed. Exclaimed: "There's the Mass-Association!" -- Like a miracle. Ordinarily it would probably taken a week.
